body:
After #1609, cancelling a shell order eventually withdraws the complete room plan, but only on the coordinator's scheduled update (every ten simulation ticks). During a pause, command dispatch still runs while scheduled systems do not. The cancelled plan continues to reserve its whole footprint indefinitely: reopening Room plans at the same origin shows "blocked" and prevents a retry until Play is pressed.

Reproduced in the real 1920×1080 browser: place Basic Cell at (10,10) while paused, cancel its first queue row, reopen Room plans at (10,10) without pressing Play. The preflight remains blocked for the full 10-second assertion timeout. A unit test also shows the pending plan survives the cancellation command and one dispatch step.

Acceptance: grouped cancellation releases the remaining shell and its footprint during the cancellation command itself, including paused play; Save/Load preserves the cleared state. This is the paused-input gap in #1609, not a change to completed-template Undo policy (#1657).
title: Cancelled room plan remains blocked until Play while the game is paused
